interpretation_guardrail: Lower MAE/RMSE is better. The primary decision statistic is position-balanced mean MAE for active-game PPG relative production. Do not select or deploy a replacement-rank family before calibration-review readiness. Weeks 1-3 are collection only; Weeks 4-7 are early diagnostics only. Promotion requires stable improvement versus the frozen legacy control across the aggregate and position-level errors and must be reconciled with the separately frozen Production V2, No-History/Rookie V2, Age Curve V2, Opportunity V2, and Durability V2 experiments.
